Subject: Panel duty reassignment and temporary fill for 7/28 SWE-2 onsite

Hi all,

Quick heads-up: our SWE-2 onsite for candidate Sam Wilson is scheduled for Tue 7/28 and we're short two panelists in the afternoon block (system design + backend deep-dive). Original panel included Priya and Marcus but both flagged OOO that week.

Neha — can you confirm whether TalentWorks can provide an alternate interviewer from their bench for the backend deep-dive? I know we usually avoid external interviewers for technical loops, but given timeline constraints an experienced IC from TalentWorks could be acceptable with hiring manager sign-off.

Internal ask: can folks volunteer to pick up 1x 60m slot on 7/28 between 1:00–3:30pm? Preferably someone who has done backend deep-dives and can ask service-design + latency questions. If nobody is available I have a fallback to split the questions across two interviewers (30m each).

I've attached the current panel schedule and a simple coverage matrix — please update your availability inline by EOD Friday. If we need to shuffle other interviewers across week-of, let's flag it now.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Hiring Manager, Infra Team
Redwood Inference

If you need a longer-term bandwidth fix, I can propose a lightweight rotation: create a rotating "oncall interviewer" roster for SWE-2 loops across infra/platform engineers. Each person would take one assigned panel week every 6 weeks (2–4 interviews total). That lets teams plan and also creates clear backfill ownership when someone is OOO.

I sketched a draft rota and linked it in the sheet (one tab). It includes shadowing options for newer interviewers (15–30m) so we don't overload senior ICs. If leadership likes the approach we can pilot for Q3.

Also — if we must use TalentWorks for one slot, Neha, please confirm they can provide a named interviewer and resume so we can share with the hiring team.

Aditya
Senior Engineering Manager

We recommend using Priya only as a backfill (paired with an internal interviewer) rather than sole owner of the technical loop.

Plan moving forward:
- Lauren will take 1:30–2:30 as primary owner.
- Logan will cover 1:30–2:00 and 2:00–2:30 if we split; otherwise he'll serve as float for live tracing questions.
- TalentWorks/Priya will be on standby to shadow and do the API surface questions only, pending Steph approval.
